source: Existing DMI14 continuous boundary-migration formula and .25 influence budget, not selected by CORE results.
domain: Original PVR-account CORE pending only, independently from decisions and opportunities; original empty, core_Q True, no barriers, cap>0, no size_reject, original industry E0/attempt/stage active. Not MOBILE registry. Reconcile all 879 actual CORE first fills. Fixed future-selected1709, static sectors, original-account-conditioned states.
original_semantics: Unique-stock rank shared by CORE/MOBILE; opening CORE first, successful reserve prevents same-stock MOBILE, failed CORE may fall back. CORE needs native i_buy and unchanged S0 qualification; MOBILE fresh CP can bypass i_buy. CORE no CP requirement. CORE original I exit remains distinct from MOBILE CP protection.

formula.name: DMI boundary migration bounded PVR credit fusion
formula.frozen_before_new_features: Formula and controls sent to parent before the first 23-point feature computation; disk protocol written after fixed cases and before any new universe feature/rank/label read.
formula.DM: up=H-Hprev; down=Lprev-L; +DM=up if up>down and up>0 else 0; -DM=down if down>up and down>0 else 0; equal outward moves and inside bars both zero.
formula.warmup: Full source prefix since 2013 common calendar, valid adjusted OHLC, source/missing/invalid reset; first14 changes simple mean; then RMA alpha1/14. d ready after14 changes; ADX descriptive after14 ready DX. No reset on I/CP/receipt.
formula.zero: d=0 and dclose=0 for strict zero denominators. Positive/negative single-side is +/-1. Warmup/invalid UNKNOWN, not zero.
formula.fusion: E=atanh((PVR-50)/50)/2; E*=E+0.25*d*max(E,0); score=50+50*tanh(2E*). Coefficient .25 is a preregistered influence budget, not claimed optimal. No threshold, reversal wait, overheat filter.
arms: same-smoothing close-DM/RSI14 with exactly same fusion
competitive high-low DMI with exactly same fusion
formula.domain: PVR account 53121 original legal empty fresh MOBILE candidates. Same date K=min(20,N), preserve original TopK sector quotas. All three scores jointly known or preserve original slot. Score rounded12 then original_priority_rank then sid.
formula.evaluation: Only after features and picks sealed; original fixed native next common OPEN to 5/20/60 common close labels; whole-day intersection when all3 methods all selected complete; date equal weighting; original root known epoch first opportunity big60 and first+5 observation capture. No account or parameter search.
formula.limitations: Consumed development history, static future universe/sector, source-version and execution uncertainty. No net closed-round win-rate/PL ratio evidence.
formula.old_adx_source: Parent reports prior in-memory old candidate: PVR/(1+(ADX/100)*max(0,-d)); not located as saved code and not claimed reproduced here.

ranking: Three arms PVR/CLOSE/DMI. Original CORE-domain global K=min(20,N) establishes each (sector,has_actual_mobile_pending) quota. Only common-known stocks can exchange slots within that same date/sector/role group. UNKNOWN exact original slot; descending rounded12 score then original priority_rank and sid. No gate or threshold. CORE role and dual fallback opportunity held equal. This conditional CORE top20 is not the complete native mixed queue and not funded buys.
evaluation: Seal scores/picks before future labels. Exact existing native next common OPEN to common close labels 5/20/60, all selected in all3 arms complete for whole-day inclusion. Day equal means plus event counts, gross and40bp price-positive only. Existing fixed native epoch first legal CORE opportunity complete60 MFE>=30%,terminal>=20%, capture by first+5 common sessions. Every year,2022,924 Sep24-Oct31,2026Q1 and Jan15-30. Denominators/UNKNOWN explicit. 60-session block descriptive paired intervals; no statistical-selection claim.
rounds: Original full0-to0 net rounds from frozen ALL_FIRST_ENTRIES.csv only. CORE entry attribution, including subsequent MOBILE layers, not isolated CORE-layer PnL. Entry-year and signal-clock groups; terminal closed and separately entry-year closed. Not a new-strategy win rate; no35% claim.
constraints: No account rerun, no parameter search, no original model changes. Inputs immutable. Only this new output directory written.
